Introducing support for Renters Insurance

Axle has expanded its insurance data platform to include renters insurance. This update enables partners to instantly verify renters policies in real time — improving compliance, reducing manual work, and enhancing the tenant onboarding experience.

Feature Spotlight: August 2025

This month we're excited to announce the launch of Axle support for a new policy type - flood insurance, and we’re highlighting major improvements to the Axle Dashboard experience for our monitoring customers.

Introducing Flood Insurance

Axle now offers wide-release support for Flood Insurance policies, enabling partners to securely verify coverage in seconds, reduce manual processes, and integrate seamlessly into existing workflows.

Insurance is the backbone of the economy

Communicating with it shouldn't be this hard.

Explore our Monitoring Agent
